prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1312; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presented with scraping and a dented panel along the right rear quarter, with paint transfer and a cracked side mirror housing, all consistent with a sideswipe while changing lanes. Most of the damage lines up with the impact as described by the owner. The repair plan calls for panel straightening, refinishing of the affected area, and replacement of the mirror housing, and the labor hours requested fit the scope of that work. The supplied invoices show no repeated charges. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed, so the current repairs are treated as tied to this loss.
